Attach per-plot field aggregates to a units sf

Source: R/qgis_import.R
attach_field_data_to_units.Rd

Spatial-joins a sf of forest units (polygons) with the sf of aggregated placettes (points). For each unit, the aggregates are averaged across the placettes it contains; units with no placettes get NAs (and field_n_trees = 0).

Usage

attach_field_data_to_units(units, field_agg)

Arguments

units

sf POLYGON. Forest management units.

field_agg

sf POINT. Output of aggregate_plot_metrics.

Value

units enriched with field_* columns.

Details

This gives indicators a uniform field_* set of columns to read, regardless of whether field data is available or not.
